newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks seen trendless as all eyes on CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks seen trendless as all eyes on CANTV.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange were seen trendless in moderate trade as investors continued to devote their energies to the domestic CANTV issue which opened Tuesday, traders said.
"The bolsa's not going to show any particular pattern until the domestic CANTV placement is done with -- there's high demand," said Cavelba broker Eduardo Blanco.
On Tuesday the market's .IBC index lost 2.14 percent to close at 5,786.21 as 31 shares fell, one rose and four stayed flat.
Over 16 million shares traded, worth 1.3 billion bolivars ($2.8 million).
